scope: Aether and GitCue interactive physical exhibits

behavior.aether: One original question, explore/belong branches, selectable return to original.
behavior.gitcue: Authored three-stage example: related changes, settling activity, descriptive commit.
behavior.delivery: 1,280×840 CanvasTexture on a physical display in each existing workshop. Native controls share shell state; no app iframe, backend, AI call or Git operation.
behavior.navigation: A workshop click enters the camera stop; a separate action reads the project. Back returns to town. Focus follows removed local controls and returns after the story.

development: Actual mesh screen hit testing through pavilion glass
Phone framing revised after neighboring-building occlusion was found

interactions: Aether choice, original thread and selected card visibly match native pressed state
Aether workshop roof click enters the close-up and retains chosen branch
GitCue commit stage rendered after Enter key with motion disabled
Aether story opens #project-aether, expands the project, and closes back to its trigger
Town Back returns focus to Take it in
Still view removes 3D; returning remounts selected GitCue commit state

limits: Authored sketches explaining the project, not live product sessions or screenshots.
Phone framing uses authored camera parameters; no general building collision system added.
The frame, console and scene architecture remain authored static geometry.
The other four selected-work exhibits retain earlier sculptures; reference-level world art and hardware profiling remain unfinished.
